newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street jumps at opening, curbs set.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street jumps at opening, curbs set.

text.p: The Dow industrials jumped more than 50 points within minutes of Wednesday's opening and the New York Stock Exchange set index-arbitrage trading curbs at 0934 EDT/1334 GMT.
The Dow Jones Industrial average rose 55 points to 7330 after the Labor Department said the Producer Price Index fell 0.6 percent in April. Excluding food and energy, the index was down 0.1 percent.
The figures were lower than expected, leading to speculation among analysts that the Federal Open Market Committee would leave interest rates untouched at its meeting Tuesday.
The long bond was up 20/32 to yield 6.87 percent. The S&P 500 futures index rose 7.56 to 840.69.
